name: 2D Texture-Based Advection with Tile Reordering
definition: A method for advecting particle traces in 3D unsteady flow using a single 2D texture on the GPU, avoiding the need for multiple copies of volume data or 3D textures by reordering the stacking direction dynamically.
summary: 2D Texture-Based Advection with Tile Reordering advects 3D flow using a single 2D texture, distinguishing itself by dynamically reordering the stacking axis to maintain visual quality.
